summary: Complaints centre on Greater Noida West's missing government hospital, school and services, waterlogging in Greater Noida West and Dadri town, and society maintenance hikes, while people appreciate the Dadri-Greater Noida overbridge, new bypasses, road widening and the CC road started in Devla.

positives.english: The Dadri to Greater Noida overbridge is built, so it has been announced
positives.hindi: दादरी से ग्रेटर नोएडा ओवरब्रिज बन गया, ऐसा कहा गया है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (18 Sep 2026, updated same day): article lists a Dadri to Greater Noida overbridge among completed works, as stated by the local MLA at a press meeting; not independently verified. Completion date and cost not given. The article is Dadri-centred and does not name the vidhan sabha; Dadri town is inside AC 62 per the Wikipedia Dadri page extent.

positives.english: The Dadri-Bulandshahr road is being widened and work is moving fast
positives.hindi: दादरी-बुलंदशहर सड़क चौड़ी हो रही है, काम तेजी से चल रहा है
positives.basis: ETV Bharat (19 Sep 2026, published 11:25 AM IST): widening of the road from Dadri via Chitehra to Bulandshahr and Sikandarabad is 'going fast' (तेजी से चल रहा है), with a median divider, two lanes each side and drains being built. Cost not stated. Under construction, not completed.

positives.english: CC road work has started in Devla, a demand we had for a long time
positives.hindi: देवला में सीसी रोड का काम शुरू, हमारी लंबे समय से मांग थी
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (26 Jun 2026, 7:55 PM IST): about 238 m CC road at Devla village, from the Dadri-Noida road to Aryavrat School, Rs 27 lakh; article says villagers had long demanded it. Work has just started, not completed. Article names Dadri as the assembly constituency.

positives.english: The Rupwas bypass is built and joined to GT Road, so it has been announced
positives.hindi: रूपवास बाईपास बनकर जीटी रोड से जुड़ गया, ऐसा कहा गया है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (18 Sep 2026): article says the Rupwas bypass was built to link with GT Road (जीटी रोड को जोड़ने के लिए रूपवास बाईपास का निर्माण कराया गया है), as stated by the local MLA; not independently verified. Cost and completion date not given.

positives.english: Railway Road to canal bypass has eased travel to Ghaziabad, so it has been announced
positives.hindi: रेलवे रोड से नहर बाईपास, गाजियाबाद जाने में राहत मिली, ऐसा कहा गया
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (18 Sep 2026): article says the bypass from Railway Road to the canal has given relief to people travelling towards Ghaziabad (रेलवे रोड से नहर बाईपास बनने से गाजियाबाद की ओर आने-जाने वाले लोगों को राहत मिली है), as stated by the local MLA; not independently verified. Article is Dadri-centred; Railway Road is taken to be in Dadri town (inside AC 62 per Wikipedia extent).

negatives.english: Greater Noida West has no full government hospital, only Bisrakh CHC to rely on
negatives.hindi: ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट में पूरा सरकारी अस्पताल नहीं, बस बिसरख सीएचसी का सहारा
negatives.basis: NCR Khabar (last updated 26 Jun 2026): Bisrakh CHC, a 30-bed community health centre, is the only government facility for the area; district hospital in Noida 35-40 min away, GIMS 50-60 min. Resident association president quoted saying Greater Noida West is home to lakhs of people. Article states Greater Noida West falls under Dadri assembly (दादरी विधानसभा क्षेत्र के अंतर्गत आने वाले ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट); Wikipedia extent says 'part of Greater Noida', without naming GNW.

negatives.english: In rain, the basement parking at Eco Village-1 in Greater Noida West fills with water
negatives.hindi: ईको विलेज-1 की बेसमेंट पार्किंग में बारिश का पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: ETV Bharat English (10 Jul 2026, 10:28 PM IST): residents of Eco Village-1 in Greater Noida West complained of waterlogging in the basement parking area, raising vehicle-safety concerns and water seeping from the basement ceiling. Replaces the earlier Tilpata item, whose AC membership could not be confirmed. AC 62 membership of Greater Noida West: Amar Ujala (25 Jul 2026) states Greater Noida West is currently part of Dadri vidhan sabha.

negatives.english: In Dadri town rain waterlogs the road, and the drainage problem is long-standing
negatives.hindi: दादरी नगर में बारिश में पानी भर जाता है, निकासी की समस्या पुरानी
negatives.basis: Raftar Today (page 'Last Updated: 7 Mar 2026'; original publication date not shown on the page): article describes waterlogging on rainy days on the GT Road to railway overbridge stretch in Dadri Nagar, a long-dilapidated road where residents faced waterlogging; officials and locals expect a drainage fix. Dadri Nagar is Dadri MB, inside AC 62 per Wikipedia extent.

negatives.english: Greater Noida West has not even one government school, cremation ground or park
negatives.hindi: ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट में सरकारी स्कूल, श्मशान घाट और पार्क तक नहीं
negatives.basis: NCR Khabar (last updated 4 Jul 2026): residents say not even one government school is available, there is no public cremation ground, and parks, stadium and Ramlila ground are lacking; a resident says 7-8 years of demand for a government multi-specialty hospital. Article states Greater Noida West falls under Dadri vidhan sabha.

negatives.english: In Greater Noida West, society maintenance has gone up and residents fear services will be cut
negatives.hindi: ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट में सोसाइटी का मेंटेनेंस बढ़ा, सुविधाएं कटने का डर
negatives.basis: NCR Khabar (last updated 6 Sep 2026; original publication date not shown): a Greater Noida West society's maintenance charges were raised; residents are unhappy; the maintenance company's email said services beyond the main facilities would be reduced; the article cites inflation, fuel prices and a guard salary rise as cost drivers. Article is filed under Dadri assembly. Source is a politics-heavy column; only the maintenance facts are used here.

round2.changes: Positives: removed Dujana bypass (foundation stone only), GT Road-overbridge CC road (foundation/launch only) and Kulesra-Surajpur-Tilpata CC road (AC unconfirmed); added Dadri-Greater Noida overbridge, Rupwas bypass and Railway Road canal bypass (Amar Ujala 18 Sep 2026); kept Devla CC road and Dadri-Bulandshahr widening; re-ranked. Negatives: replaced Tilpata (AC membership unconfirmed; not in Wikipedia extent, no source names its vidhan sabha) with Eco Village-1 basement waterlogging (ETV Bharat 10 Jul 2026, plus Amar Ujala 25 Jul 2026 naming Dadri vidhan sabha for Greater Noida West); kept the other four, with basis rewritten to remove politics and names and dates labelled as last-updated where no publication date is shown. Summary updated. Removed sources: Raftar Today 4 May 2026 (Dujana) and Chetna Manch 19 Sep 2026 (Tilpata). Added sources: Amar Ujala 18 Sep and 25 Jul 2026, ETV Bharat 10 Jul 2026.

notes: AC 62 Dadri confirmed from the Wikipedia constituency list (No. 62, Dadri, Reservation None, Lok Sabha Gautam Buddh Nagar). The Wikipedia Dadri, Uttar Pradesh page extent names Dadri (Dadri MB, Dadri tehsil), villages of Bisrakh block (Kacheda Warsabad, Kamnagar, Bisrakh Jalalpur, Patwari, Chipiyana Bujurg, Chhapraula, Roza Yakubpur, Haibatpur, Khodana Kalan, Saini, Khedi, Khairpur Gujar, Achheja) and Surajpur (Greater Noida). Greater Noida West is not named on Wikipedia; it is 'part of Greater Noida'. Its AC 62 membership rests on news reports naming Dadri vidhan sabha for Greater Noida West (NCR Khabar 26 Jun and 4 Jul 2026; Amar Ujala 25 Jul 2026). Not confirmed inside AC 62: Tilpata and Kulesra (Wikipedia does not name them; no source names their vidhan sabha, and the Hindi web search found nothing). Surajpur is named on Wikipedia as Surajpur (Greater Noida), but no source ties the Kulesra-Surajpur road to AC 62. Dropped items: Dujana-Dadri bypass (foundation only), GT Road overbridge CC road (foundation/launch only), Kulesra-Surajpur-Tilpata road and Tilpata waterlogging (AC unconfirmed). Bil Akbarpur (ETV 2024) was excluded earlier because its AC is not confirmed. Dates: Raftar Today (7 Mar 2026) and NCR Khabar (26 Jun, 4 Jul, 6 Sep 2026) show last-updated dates; no original publication date was visible, so these are last-updated dates. Amar Ujala (26 Jun, 18 Sep, 25 Jul 2026) and ETV Bharat (19 Sep, 10 Jul 2026) show publication dates. Positives 1, 4 and 5 rest on MLA statements reported in Amar Ujala 18 Sep 2026 and are not independently verified; the article does not give completion dates or costs for the overbridge, Rupwas bypass or Railway Road bypass. Field check advised. Haryana's Dadri (Charkhi Dadri) was excluded.
